**[⬇ Download AutoApplicator.dmg](https://github.com/grabbiel/auto-applicator/releases/latest/download/AutoApplicator.dmg)** · needs a Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) and macOS 14 or newer.

1. Open the disk image and drag **Auto Applicator** onto **Applications**.
2. Open it from Applications. If macOS says it can't check the app for malicious software, open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll to the message about *Auto Applicator* and click **Open Anyway**. This happens only once.
3. Click **Start setup**: about five minutes, and the app explains each step.

Version 1.2.0 and newer update themselves: an **Update** button appears in the app, and the new version installs when you quit it. For an older version, drag the new one over it once. Your data stays where it is.
